description.tagline: Shot functionality for your daily life
description.intro: The adidas Tiro bag brings together the line's classic sports look with a construction designed for everyday use. A practical and resistant design for training, traveling or moving around the city with your equipment organized.
key_benefits: Versatile design: Perfect for both training and travel.
Durable material: Made of durable polyester that withstands intensive use.
Optimal capacity: Space to store clothing, footwear and sports accessories.
Comfort in transport: Reinforced handles and adjustable strap for easy carrying.

source.intro: La bolsa adidas Tiro reúne el look deportivo clásico de la línea con una construcción pensada para el uso diario. Un diseño práctico y resistente para entrenar, viajar o moverte por la ciudad con tu equipación organizada.
